strengths: Exact part-number search works: /catalogsearch/result/?q=FI-TE-04LLMK-W3-MS returns the one matching SKU with price and Add to Cart, and results pages are correctly noindexed

Product JSON-LD is unusually complete for a small distributor: Product, Offer with price/currency, shippingDetails (handling 2-5 days, $9.99) and MerchantReturnPolicy, plus BreadcrumbList on every PDP and category
The Engineering Toolbox (/engineering-toolbox/) is a genuine in-browser hydraulic calculator suite (cylinder force/area/speed, pumps, conversions) with 'Shop Cylinders' links back into the catalog
